claim: The antioxidant response accompanying Pmp22/myelin RNA loss in Nae1-deficient developing nerves is not reproduced by developmental Tsc1 or Pten loss, despite their shared differentiation phenotype.
context: GSE241269 P7 Mpz-Cre Nae1 cKO versus WT, and Figlia2017 PRJEB20661 P5 Dhh-Cre Tsc1/Pten/Raptor knockouts versus source developmental controls. Whole sciatic nerves, different ages/drivers/cohorts. No direct NRF2 intervention or mediation estimate.
baseline_model: A generic myelination-arrest/mTOR-expression explanation predicts a comparable antioxidant signature in Tsc1 and Pten knockouts. A neddylation-associated parallel program predicts substantially greater antioxidant induction in Nae1 loss while Pmp22 and myelin genes decline in all three.
discovery_sources: PMC8168556 Results MLN4924 treatment suppresses neuroendocrine cell state
prior_exposure: Nae1 complete effect screen already executed: Nqo1/Slc7a11 among extremes. Nae1 discovery is retrospective. Other antioxidant genes have not been selected from a targeted Nae1 inspection. Five-gene panel chosen from inspected primary neddylation literature, not comparator outcomes. Figlia paper shared mTOR/myelination phenotype read. Workbook header inspection accidentally included first non-header rows Cldn11/Pmel, explicitly exposed; none is a selected antioxidant/myelin outcome. No selected comparator gene values inspected yet. Not fully blinded; public data and model priors acknowledged. This is an independent-source comparator test, not replication of Nae1 effect.
prediction: Five-gene antioxidant panel Nqo1,Hmox1,Gclc,Gclm,Osgin1 mean KO/control log2 effect exceeds +1 in Nae1 with at least four of five positive. In each Tsc1 and Pten knockout, its source mean log2 Ratio is below +1 and at least 1 log2 below Nae1. Pmp22 and fixed seven-myelin-marker mean Mpz,Mbp,Mag,Prx,Plp1,Cnp,Mal decline in both Tsc1 and Pten; Nae1 decline already known. Raptor is a secondary opposite-mTOR comparator and cannot rescue primary.
analysis_plan: Use source native gene_name exactly, confirm human annotations only as annotations. Unique source row per required gene in each contrast sheet; isPresent must be TRUE and finite nonnegative counts. Baseline Dev1-3 normalized count>=10 each for all required genes; treated counts may be valid zero. If required gene absent/ineligible do not reduce panel or zero-fill. Dev1-3 Control,4-6 TSC1KO,7-9 RaptorKO,10-12 PTENKO based on ENA sample_alias and title; prefix correspondence provisional and must be corroborated by contrast-wide reported log2 ratios outside all tested panels before interpreting sample intervals. Primary comparator effect uses source log2 Ratio, not recomputed DE. Discovery uses existing median-ratio normalized effects with +0.5 pseudocount. Compute sample-wise panel scores, Welch intervals and leave-one-sample-out only if metadata/whole-matrix audit supports the sample map. Keep shared three controls shared, not nine independent controls. No cross-study pooling or p-values for gene-set means as independent genes. Compare normalization, pseudocount and omit-one-gene sensitivity; exploratory whole-universe effect concordance and source mTOR-induced/repressed sets assess broad sharing.
success_rule: All required features and contrast identity eligible; Nae1 panel mean>1 and at least4/5 positive; both Tsc1 and Pten antioxidant panel means<1 and each >=1 below Nae1; Pmp22 and seven-marker means negative in both. Supports separable measured programs in these sources only, not NRF2-to-PMP22 causality.
failure_rule: Eligible data failing any conjunct is not validation. Missing/failed required genes or unresolved contrast direction renders affected primary comparison untestable. No rescue through Raptor, marker removal, alternate panels or favorable strata. Greater antioxidant signal in Nae1 without comparable state controls remains descriptive and cannot by itself attribute specificity.
confounder_checks: Check native row eligibility before arithmetic; selected source universe not full genome
Check baseline count floors, all-pairwise effects and sample deletion
Compare myelin, sterol, immune and fibroblast responses
Audit broad concordance and primary-paper novelty; known neddylation-NRF2 mechanism is not a new discovery
Do not infer NRF2 protein/nuclear activity from Nfe2l2 RNA or ferroptosis from Slc7a11 alone
P5/P7, Cre drivers and bulk composition may explain differences; no causal mediation
selection_and_multiplicity: One conjoint comparator claim motivated by a transcriptome-wide extreme; five markers externally selected from primary neddylation studies. This is not a genome-wide significance claim. Slc7a11 is exploratory because of multiple upstream pathways. Independent comparator has three mice/group, shared controls; n=genes is not biological n. Validation of difference from mTOR comparators is not independent replication of the Nae1 antioxidant program.
